hard_case: An un-awaited `expect(p).resolves.toBe(x)` cannot fail its test; jest 30 reports the test passed and only the worker's late unhandled rejection fails the run.

truth.toolchain: node 22.23.4; jest 30.5.2 with ts-jest 29.4.14 (the subject's pinned versions); edit applied by hand and `npx jest --ci` run on the whole package

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: atLimit(100) is true, not false

reasoning: The test calls `expect(Promise.resolve(atLimit(100))).resolves.toBe(true)` with no `await` and no `return`. The edit makes atLimit(100) false, and `npx jest --ci` fails: jest 30 on node 22 crashes the worker with the unhandled `JestAssertionError` and exits 1, although the test itself is reported passed (a late-settling promise behaves the same: the run exits 1 with the suite reported passed). The failure is a process-level race, not an attributable test failure, so ripr withholds the credit and reads `static_unknown` (abstained) instead of `exposed` with an exact_value oracle.
